description: One LaTeX formula in (math mode, no dollar signs). Back come what it reads as, the words a screen reader says for it, the text it copies out as, and its MathML. Free without a key, thirty formulas every ten minutes; with a key, a tenth of a cent each.

tex.description: The formula, for example \frac{a}{b} or e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0.

name: read_formula
title: Read a formula
